# Stargate Telcom

> Decentralized internet at the edge. Fibre and satellite connectivity, present at the home and with you as you move.

- Canonical site: https://www.stargatetelcom.io/
- Same site: https://www.stargatetelcom.com/
- Also: https://stargatetelcom.io/ and https://stargatetelcom.com/
- Email: hello@stargatetelcom.com

## Offerings

- Home: fast fibre, dedicated to the household, always on.
- Roam: buy once, use every hotspot on the network.
- Boost: a named speed for a named window, then the session returns.
- Marketplace: routers and network equipment on the same platform.

## How it is delivered

Distributed telecom at the core. Last mile is fibre and satellite. One identity across Home, Roam, Boost, and Marketplace.
